name: Introduction to Python
desc: Master the basics of data analysis with Python in just four hours. This online course will introduce the Python interface and explore popular packages.

desc: Accompanied at every step with hands-on practice queries, this course teaches you everything you need to know to analyze data using your own SQL code today!
